test_title: PYST 175: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 17th Nov, 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Two years ago, T was twice as old as P. P is thrice as old as R. In five years, P will be 29. What is the present age of T?
solution:
Given: Two years ago, T was twice as old as P. P is thrice as old as R. In five years, P will be 29. 

According to the question,

Two years ago, T was twice as old as P.

 
• T - 2 = 2 × (P - 2); _________(i)

At present, P is thrice as old as R.

 
• P = 3 × R; ____________(ii)

In five years, P will be 29. 

 
• P + 5 = 29
 
• P = 29 - 5 = 24 years

Now, by substituting the age of P, we get,

 
• T - 2 = 2 × (P - 2)
 
• T - 2 = 2 × (24 - 2)
 
• T - 2 = 2 × 22
 
• T = 44 + 2
 
• T = 46 years

Hence, the present age of T is **46 years.**
